name: balancer
description: Balances subagent work between Claude models and Codex CLI by quota: auto, light, medium, full.

mode.title: Default balance mode
mode.description: off: no routing, the mod only shows quotas and runs Codex when asked. auto: by quota pace. light: Claude first, Codex for bounded code tasks. medium: code split by quota. full: Codex for all code, Claude orchestrates and reviews.

codexEffort.title: Default Codex reasoning effort
codexEffort.description: low to ultra; not every model supports max or ultra.

stallMinutes.title: Codex stall warning (minutes)
stallMinutes.description: Warn when a running Codex job writes nothing for this long. Raise it if your jobs run long silent test suites.
